status.waitingForStream: The server is preparing the stream…
status.switching: Switching … playback continues at the same position.

errors.no_compatible_format: This browser cannot play this file, not even after converting it.
errors.transcode_unavailable: This file needs converting, but the server can only Direct Play and Remux.
errors.session_limit_reached: Too many videos are playing on the server right now. Try again in a moment.
errors.stream_not_ready: The server could not prepare the stream in time.

quality.heading: Quality
quality.hint: Steps below the source convert the video. Applies to this device.
quality.hintNone: The source is below the smallest step. Applies to this device.

audio.heading: Audio
audio.single: This file has only one audio track.
audio.none: This file has no audio track.

subtitles.heading: Subtitles
subtitles.burnIn: is burned in – the video is converted
subtitles.refused: Not possible right now: the server cannot burn in.

toast.burnInUnavailable: This subtitle has to be burned into the video. The server cannot do that right now (transcoding limit reached or transcoding switched off). Subtitles stay off.
toast.bitRateCap: The quality limit is below the source – the video is converted.

badge.label: Stream info, mode: {{mode}}
badge.allCopied: Nothing is converted: the file is delivered as it is.

hint.audio_codec_not_supported: Choose an AAC track to avoid converting.
hint.audio_channels_not_supported: Choose a stereo or 5.1 track to avoid converting.
hint.audio_track_not_first: Choose the first audio track to play the file as it is.
hint.subtitle_burn_in: Choose a text subtitle or switch subtitles off to avoid burning in.
hint.video_downscaled: Choose "Original" quality to keep the full resolution.
hint.subtitle_burn_in_unavailable: Choose a text subtitle or try again later.

reason.video_bit_depth_not_supported: Video bit depth of {{sourceCodec}} not supported → {{targetCodec}}
reason.audio_track_not_first: The selected audio track is not the first one, and browsers play only the first track of a file
reason.disc_source: DVDs and Blu-rays are never played directly → {{targetContainer}}
reason.subtitle_burn_in: {{sourceCodec}} subtitles are an image format and are burned into the video, which converts it
reason.bitrate_cap: The quality limit is below the source bit rate, so the video is converted
reason.dsd_to_pcm: DSD audio is always converted to PCM
reason.hires_downsampled: The audio exceeds what this device plays and is reduced
reason.hwaccel_unavailable: No hardware encoder is available, so the video is encoded in software

warning.hdr_not_tone_mapped: HDR is converted without tone mapping, so colours may look pale
warning.subtitle_burn_in_unavailable: The server cannot burn in the chosen subtitle right now, so subtitles stay off
